note: One row per mechanic per game. Cross-game rows are linked via shared mechanic_id families so the same mechanic found in two games is NOT counted as two different features.

mechanics.name: Break eggs with pickaxe
mechanics.description: Eggs have hit points; repeatedly swing a pickaxe until the egg breaks and hatches an animal.
mechanics.trigger: Player attacks egg with equipped pickaxe
mechanics.requirements: Equipped pickaxe; stronger eggs in deeper biomes require stronger pickaxes
mechanics.gameplay_flow: approach egg → swing → egg HP depletes → hatches → alert raised
player_decisions: which egg to attempt based on pickaxe tier vs. guard risk

mechanics.name: Guards pursue egg-breakers
mechanics.description: Territory guards near eggs chase the player after an egg is broken; contact makes the player drop the animal.
mechanics.trigger: Breaking an egg (and/or carrying a hatched animal) near guards
mechanics.gameplay_flow: break → alert → chase → escape or get caught → drop animal → lose the run
player_decisions: invest in speed vs. accept loss risk
mechanics.note: Guards are also fling/throw hazards (FlingDistance), not just chasers. Exact catch→drop outcome still needs OBS-BSE-03.

mechanics.name: Deposit animals at base for cash
mechanics.description: Carried animals are placed in the player's base and generate cash.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: escape guards → deposit → cash
player_decisions: when to bank vs. go for a rarer egg

mechanics.name: Treadmill speed training
mechanics.description: Players train Speed (on a treadmill per third-party guide) to outrun guards and reach deeper biomes.
mechanics.requirements: Access to treadmill in Safe Zone
mechanics.gameplay_flow: train → speed stat up → reach farther biomes / escape guards
player_decisions: how much to train vs. how much to steal
mechanics.note: Confirmed live: speed is trained on treadmills in the player's own plot and gates zone access via ZonesConfig.RequiredPower.

mechanics.name: Index (collection log)
mechanics.description: Collected animals are recorded in an Index — 'Collect them all in the Index!'.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: collect → index fills → completion goal

mechanics.name: Steal eggs from world pets
mechanics.description: Eggs are taken from pets in the world.
mechanics.trigger: Player steals an egg from a pet
mechanics.gameplay_flow: locate pet → steal egg → carry

mechanics.name: Steal eggs from other players
mechanics.description: Players can take eggs directly from other players — a headline mechanic in the official description.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: approach target → steal → escape with egg

mechanics.name: Hatch eggs into rare pets
mechanics.description: Stolen eggs hatch into pets which earn money; rarity, size and mutation axes exist.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: egg → pet → passive money → upgrades

mechanics.name: Treadmill speed training + base upgrade
mechanics.description: Train Speed on an upgradable treadmill; upgrade base. Speed presumably improves stealing success and escape.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: earn → upgrade treadmill/base → faster → reach rarer eggs

mechanics.name: Pet sizes and mutations
mechanics.description: 11 weighted size scale bands (0.1x → 35x, hard cap 150x) and 11 mutation variants; income is tapered against size (diminishing returns).
mechanics.gameplay_flow: hatch → roll size/mutation → rarer variants sought

mechanics.name: Bat flinging to steal eggs
mechanics.description: 13 index-gated bats (force 35 → 99.86, range +0 → +20.6 studs, duration 0.5 → 1.43s). Base bat description: 'Fling players and steal their eggs!'. Client cd 0.6s, server 0.7s.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: equip bat → swing → fling player → steal egg

mechanics.name: Area guardians with retrieval/deposit
mechanics.description: 16 guard configs (one per area + 3 Light/Dark variants). WalkSpeed 16 → 251.075, HitDistance 2.5 → 7, attack ragdoll 2.5s, knockback; retrieve stolen eggs and DEPOSIT them at home (GuardRetrieval). Some guards have EggPickupDistance 18 and carry eggs.
mechanics.trigger: Player steals or carries egg in area
mechanics.gameplay_flow: theft → guard wakes/chases → hits → may retrieve egg and deposit back

mechanics.name: Defensive traps and tools
mechanics.description: Trap (1000 cash, freeze thieves 7s, 3 max), BigTrap, GravityDisruptor (slow 50%, 3 max), BeeLauncher (10000 cash, invert controls 5s, cd 58s). Starter kit: 1 bat + 3 traps.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: place defense → thief hits → frozen/slowed/inverted controls

mechanics.name: Carry penalty while holding eggs
mechanics.description: Carrying eggs slows you down up to 33% (MAX_CARRY_SLOWDOWN 0.33), tapering by biome (0.33 early, down to 0.154 in Light Dark). Curve power 1.2.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: pick up egg → reduced movement speed → higher exposure

mechanics.name: Shrine Fusion (3 pets)
mechanics.description: Fuse 3 pets together; cost priced in minutes of income (3 minutes), with mutation surcharges (x2 if 1 mutation, x3 if many), bias strength 0.6.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: select 3 → pay minutes-of-income → biased roll → result

mechanics.name: Area index completion unlocks bats and rewards
mechanics.description: Completing each area's index unlocks that area's bat gear (IndexBatGearId) and grants IndexSpeedReward per pet; also tied to collection completion goals.
mechanics.requirements: collect all pets in that area
mechanics.gameplay_flow: hatch/obtain missing entries → index completes → bat unlocked + rewards

mechanics.name: Find eggs around the map
mechanics.description: Eggs are scattered across the map and must be located and carried back.
mechanics.trigger: Player finds and picks up an egg
mechanics.gameplay_flow: explore → find egg → carry back → hatch

mechanics.name: Ride hatched pets as mounts
mechanics.description: Hatched pets become rideable mounts whose speed determines how far and how fast the player can travel.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: hatch → ride → cover ground → reach rarer eggs
mechanics.note: Key structural difference vs. the other two games: speed comes from the PET, not from a trained stat.

mechanics.name: Mutate pets for more speed
mechanics.description: Pets can be mutated (rerolled at the gears shop) to increase speed.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: earn → reroll → faster pet → rarer eggs
consequences: cost consumed; whether reroll is random is UNVERIFIED
mechanics.player_decisions: how many rerolls to buy (gambling-like risk)

mechanics.name: Sell items at sell point
mechanics.description: A sell interaction exists (video shows a sell station and item worth dialogue).
mechanics.gameplay_flow: obtain → sell → cash

mechanics.name: Rebirth system (claimed)
mechanics.description: A community wiki has a Rebirths page describing requirements, gems and multiplier rewards.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: unknown
mechanics.note: Only the existence of a wiki page was captured. Not confirmed in-game. The other two games have NO rebirth evidence at all (UNKNOWN, not absent).

mechanics.name: Collection log / index
mechanics.description: Placeholder cross-link: collection logs confirmed in break_steal_egg (official) and ride_a_pet (video), implied but not confirmed in steal_egg.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: n/a
mechanics.note: Row exists to prevent double-counting. Per-game index entries live at BSE-index and RAP-index (pending).

mechanics.name: Zone access gated by SpeedPower
mechanics.description: Each of the 10 zones requires a cumulative SpeedPower value to enter: 5, 1k, 50k, 750k, 12M, 150M, 1B, 5B, 25B, 100B.
mechanics.trigger: Attempting to enter a zone beyond current SpeedPower
mechanics.gameplay_flow: train speed → pass gate → new egg pool with higher rarity floor → higher cash
consequences: zones 1-2 only reach Epic; zone 10 floor is Divine
mechanics.player_decisions: how to split earnings between speed training and other sinks

mechanics.name: Zone-gated bats (knockback weapons)
mechanics.description: Ten bat/hammer tiers, one unlocked per zone, with range 15→30 and knockback 17.5→48. Used to knock other players around (knockback/ragdoll physics parameters present).
mechanics.trigger: Swinging a bat at another player
mechanics.requirements: Bat tier unlocked for the current zone (BatUnlockRemote)
mechanics.gameplay_flow: enter zone → claim bat → knock rivals away from eggs/escapes
mechanics.player_decisions: fight over an egg vs. flee with a carried animal
mechanics.note: First direct evidence of player-vs-player COMBAT (not just theft) in any of the three games.

mechanics.name: Animal mutations
mechanics.description: Five mutations roll on hatched animals: Shiny 1/30 (x2 cash), Golden 1/100 (x3.5), Diamond 1/300 (x6), Radioactive 1/750 (x12), Rainbow 1/2000 (x25).
mechanics.requirements: Golden requires Gold variant, Diamond requires Diamond variant (merge-machine variants)
mechanics.gameplay_flow: hatch → roll mutation → cash multiplier on placement
mechanics.player_decisions: keep vs. keep hatching for better rolls
mechanics.note: Steal An Egg officially claims size+mutation axes; Ride A Pet claims mutation. BSE now has OBSERVED mutations too — mutation is NOT unique to any one of them.

mechanics.name: Pity system (new-player protection)
mechanics.description: After 330s of playtime without a Rare+, the game grants a Rare–Epic hatch in zones 1–2, worth 3,500–5,000 cash. Expires after 1,800s.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: play → guaranteed rare → avoid early-quit frustration
mechanics.note: Deliberate new-player-retention mechanic. No equivalent has been found in steal_egg or ride_a_pet (UNKNOWN, not absent).

mechanics.name: Lucky Egg events
mechanics.description: Announced Lucky Eggs parachute into zones (up to 8/zone, 2 default) with boosted health (x1.2-1.35), pet luck (x1.1-1.2), boss pet luck x2, mutation luck (x1.5-2) and size luck (x1.2-1.35); awards the 'Lucky' badge.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: announcement → race to the egg → boosted rewards
mechanics.player_decisions: abandon current run to chase the lucky egg?

mechanics.name: Merge machine (real-time egg growth)
mechanics.description: Up to 3 eggs grow in real time (10s base, ×rarity multiplier up to ×5 Omega, max 7 days) and can roll Diamond/Gold variants. Growth can be skipped with Robux products.
mechanics.trigger: Placing an egg in the machine
mechanics.gameplay_flow: place egg → wait (or pay) → reveal grown egg/variant
consequences: long real-time waits create a return-visit hook
mechanics.player_decisions: wait vs. pay to skip; which eggs to grow

mechanics.name: Offline rewards
mechanics.description: Returning after 60s–5h offline accrues a claimable reward (rate ×0.1, multiplier ×2); a Robux claim product exists.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: return → claim → immediate reward

mechanics.name: Group join + like + favorite reward
mechanics.description: Claim +10,000 Speed by joining group 187288153 and liking/favoriting the game; 45s prompt cooldown.
mechanics.gameplay_flow: social actions → free speed
mechanics.note: Official description advertises 'join the group for free rewards' — now confirmed with exact value.
